text: Ye jaante hue ki har saal meri birthday kaise manati hai. Apne birthday se ek mahina pehle jo main khab dekhne chalu kar deti hun ki oh my god log mere liye chand tare shakkar pare leke aayenge. Mera saal ka sabse ghatiya din zyada hai mera birthday. Har saal ye track record hai ki main apne birthday pe roi hun. Ab main apna munh saja ke baith gayi hun ki hai hai meri birthday aa rahi hai. Badhiya niklegi, koi badhiya nahi niklegi. Mujhe bhi pata hai rona machne wala hai us din.
